verses.greek: Διὰ τοῦτο δεῖ περισσοτέρως προσέχειν ἡμᾶς τοῖς ἀκουσθεῖσιν, μήποτε παραρυῶμεν.
verses.literal: Because of this it behooves more abundantly to give heed us to the things we have heard otherwise we may drift away.
verses.dgt: For this reason we must pay much closer attention to what we have heard, lest we drift away.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ὁ διʼ ἀγγέλων λαληθεὶς λόγος ἐγένετο βέβαιος, καὶ πᾶσα παράβασις καὶ παρακοὴ ἔλαβεν ἔνδικον μισθαποδοσίαν,
verses.literal: If for the through angels having been spoken word was unalterable and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense
verses.dgt: For if the word spoken through angels proved firm, and every transgression and disobedience received a just repayment,

verses.greek: πῶς ἡμεῖς ἐκφευξόμεθα τηλικαύτης ἀμελήσαντες σωτηρίας, ἥτις, ἀρχὴν λαβοῦσα λαλεῖσθαι διὰ τοῦ κυρίου, ὑπὸ τῶν ἀκουσάντων εἰς ἡμᾶς ἐβεβαιώθη,
verses.literal: how we ourselves will escape such a great having neglected a salvation? which a commencement having received declaring through the Lord by those having heard to us it was confirmed
verses.dgt: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation? It began to be spoken through the Lord and was confirmed to us by those who heard,

verses.greek: συνεπιμαρτυροῦντος τοῦ θεοῦ σημείοις τε καὶ τέρασιν καὶ ποικίλαις δυνάμεσιν καὶ πνεύματος ἁγίου μερισμοῖς κατὰ τὴν αὐτοῦ θέλησιν;
verses.literal: bearing witness the God by signs together with them and by wonders and by various miracles and of the Spirit Holy by distributions according to the of Him will.
verses.dgt: while God also bore witness by signs and wonders and various miracles and distributions of the Holy Spirit according to his will.

verses.greek: Οὐ γὰρ ἀγγέλοις ὑπέταξεν τὴν οἰκουμένην τὴν μέλλουσαν, περὶ ἧς λαλοῦμεν·
verses.literal: Not for to angels did He subject the world which is coming concerning which we are speaking
verses.dgt: For he did not subject to angels the world to come, about which we are speaking.

verses.greek: διεμαρτύρατο δέ πού τις λέγων· Τί ἐστιν ἄνθρωπος ὅτι μιμνῄσκῃ αὐτοῦ, ἢ υἱὸς ἀνθρώπου ὅτι ἐπισκέπτῃ αὐτόν;
verses.literal: Has testified however somewhere someone saying What is man that You are mindful of him or the son of man that You care for him?
verses.dgt: But someone testified somewhere, saying, “What is a human being that you remember him, or a son of man that you care for him?

verses.greek: ἠλάττωσας αὐτὸν βραχύ τι παρʼ ἀγγέλους, δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφάνωσας αὐτόν,
verses.literal: You made lower him a little some than the angels with glory and with honor You crowned him
verses.dgt: You made him a little lower than angels; you crowned him with glory and honor;

verses.greek: πάντα ὑπέταξας ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ· ἐν τῷ γὰρ ὑποτάξαι τὰ πάντα οὐδὲν ἀφῆκεν αὐτῷ ἀνυπότακτον. νῦν δὲ οὔπω ὁρῶμεν αὐτῷ τὰ πάντα ὑποτεταγμένα·
verses.literal: all things You have put in subjection under the feet of him. In the for subjecting the all things no thing He left to him unsubject At present however not yet do we see to Him the all things subjected.
verses.dgt: you subjected all things under his feet.” For in subjecting all things to him, he left nothing not subject to him. But now we do not yet see all things subjected to him.

verses.greek: τὸν δὲ βραχύ τι παρʼ ἀγγέλους ἠλαττωμένον βλέπομεν Ἰησοῦν διὰ τὸ πάθημα τοῦ θανάτου δόξῃ καὶ τιμῇ ἐστεφανωμένον, ὅπως χωρὶς θεοῦ ὑπὲρ παντὸς γεύσηται θανάτου.
verses.literal: Who however a little one than the angels made lower we see Jesus because of the suffering the of death with glory and with honor crowned so that χωρὶς of God for everyone He may taste death.
verses.dgt: But we see Jesus, who was made a little lower than angels, crowned with glory and honor because of the suffering of death, so that by the grace of God he might taste death for everyone.

verses.greek: Ἔπρεπεν γὰρ αὐτῷ, διʼ ὃν τὰ πάντα καὶ διʼ οὗ τὰ πάντα, πολλοὺς υἱοὺς εἰς δόξαν ἀγαγόντα τὸν ἀρχηγὸν τῆς σωτηρίας αὐτῶν διὰ παθημάτων τελειῶσαι.
verses.literal: It was fitting for to Him for whom are the all things and through whom are the all things many sons to glory having brought the archetype of the salvation of them through sufferings to make perfect.
verses.dgt: For it was fitting for him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many sons to glory, to perfect the founder of their salvation through sufferings.

verses.greek: ὅ τε γὰρ ἁγιάζων καὶ οἱ ἁγιαζόμενοι ἐξ ἑνὸς πάντες· διʼ ἣν αἰτίαν οὐκ ἐπαισχύνεται ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοὺς καλεῖν,
verses.literal: The One both for sanctifying and those being sanctified of one are all for which reason not He is ashamed brothers them to call
verses.dgt: For both the one who sanctifies and those being sanctified are all from one; for this reason he is not ashamed to call them brothers and sisters,

verses.greek: λέγων· Ἀπαγγελῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς μου, ἐν μέσῳ ἐκκλησίας ὑμνήσω σε·
verses.literal: saying: I will declare the name of You to the brothers of Mine in the midst of the congregation I will sing praises of you.
verses.dgt: saying, “I will proclaim your name to my brothers; in the midst of the assembly I will sing praise to you.”

verses.greek: καὶ πάλιν· Ἐγὼ ἔσομαι πεποιθὼς ἐπʼ αὐτῷ· καὶ πάλιν· Ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καὶ τὰ παιδία ἅ μοι ἔδωκεν ὁ θεός.
verses.literal: And again: I myself will be already trusting in Him. And again: Behold I myself and the children whom to Me has given the God.
verses.dgt: And again, “I will put my trust in him.” And again, “Look, I and the children God has given me.”

verses.greek: Ἐπεὶ οὖν τὰ παιδία κεκοινώνηκεν αἵματος καὶ σαρκός, καὶ αὐτὸς παραπλησίως μετέσχεν τῶν αὐτῶν, ἵνα διὰ τοῦ θανάτου καταργήσῃ τὸν τὸ κράτος ἔχοντα τοῦ θανάτου, τοῦτʼ ἔστι τὸν διάβολον,
verses.literal: Since therefore the children have partaken of blood and of flesh also He himself likewise took part in the same things so that through the His death He may destroy the one the power holding the of death That is the devil
verses.dgt: Therefore, since the children share in blood and flesh, he likewise shared in the same things, so that through death he might render powerless the one who has the power of death, that is, the devil,

verses.greek: καὶ ἀπαλλάξῃ τούτους, ὅσοι φόβῳ θανάτου διὰ παντὸς τοῦ ζῆν ἔνοχοι ἦσαν δουλείας.
verses.literal: and may set free those as many as fear of death through all times of them to live subject they were to slavery.
verses.dgt: and free all those who through fear of death were subject to slavery throughout their lives.

verses.greek: οὐ γὰρ δήπου ἀγγέλων ἐπιλαμβάνεται, ἀλλὰ σπέρματος Ἀβραὰμ ἐπιλαμβάνεται.
verses.literal: Not for surely somewhere the angels He helps but the seed of Abraham He helps.
verses.dgt: For surely it is not angels he takes hold of, but he takes hold of Abraham’s offspring.

verses.greek: ὅθεν ὤφειλεν κατὰ πάντα τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ὁμοιωθῆναι, ἵνα ἐλεήμων γένηται καὶ πιστὸς ἀρχιερεὺς τὰ πρὸς τὸν θεόν, εἰς τὸ ἱλάσκεσθαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας τοῦ λαοῦ·
verses.literal: Therefore it was necessary in all things the His brothers to be made like so that a merciful He may become and faithful high priest in the things relating to the God in order the to make propitiation for the sins of the people.
verses.dgt: Therefore he had to become like his brothers and sisters in every way, so that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in matters relating to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

verses.greek: ἐν ᾧ γὰρ πέπονθεν αὐτὸς πειρασθείς, δύναται τοῖς πειραζομένοις βοηθῆσαι.
verses.literal: In that for has suffered He Himself having been tempted He is able those being tempted to help.
verses.dgt: For because he himself suffered when tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
